description: Synthetic Team 3 demo: one prediction per step, values are % change from a resting baseline. Not participant data.

phases.title: Resting
phases.note: Both states predict Low. Low never issues feedback.

phases.title: Frustration rises to Medium
phases.note: Medium is predicted, but Medium never issues feedback.

phases.title: Two Highs, then a Medium
phases.note: The High count reaches 2 of 3, then the Medium prediction resets it to 0.

phases.title: Three consecutive Highs
phases.note: The third consecutive High prediction issues cause-specific frustration feedback.

phases.title: Fatigue rises to Medium
phases.note: HRV falls past the Medium thresholds. Medium never issues feedback.

phases.title: Three consecutive High fatigue predictions
phases.note: The third consecutive High prediction issues fatigue feedback.
